chunks: We have determined for each community a way of worship which they follow. So they should not contend with you in this matter; and you should go on calling them to your Lord. You are surely on the right path.
ai.seo_question: What does the term 'Manasik' mean in the context of Surah Al-Hajj?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the concept of *Tawqifiyyah* (divine prescription) in rituals, affirming that while the core of worship is universal, specific rites are divinely ordained for each community. It serves as a reassurance to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) to remain steadfast in his mission, trusting in his straight path despite the disputes of those who follow their own *manasik*. This underscores the balance between distinct ritual practices and the unity of the call to Tawhid.
